summary: Ardent Health filed an 8-K to revise non-GAAP measures in its 2025 Form 10-K, removing $97.7 million in aggregate adjustments related to an accounts receivable accounting estimate and a New Mexico professional liability accrual, both from Q3 2025. Adjusted EBITDA fell from $545.0M to $447.3M, and Adjusted EBITDAR from $709.3M to $611.6M for 2025. No restatement of GAAP financials or prior periods was made. This is a routine disclosure revision, not a special situation.
